sources.label: USGS event detail
sources.coverage: The products USGS lists for one earthquake
sources.attribution: U.S. Geological Survey, Earthquake Hazards Program

notes.shakemap: ShakeMap is the USGS's modelled estimate of shaking intensity (Modified Mercalli Intensity, MMI), combining recordings with ground-motion models. It is versioned and can change; it is not a measurement at every place.
notes.contours: Each contour is a line of equal estimated intensity (an isoseismal), coloured as USGS colours it.
